description: reCAPTCHA v2 / hCaptcha checkbox on the current page: clicks "I'm not a robot" with human-like input and reports the result. If an image challenge opens, returns its screenshot and viewport box: solve it with your vision using click_at (x = box.x + x in image, y = box.y + y in image), click its Verify button the same way, then call solve_captcha with checkOnly to confirm the token. Cloudflare Turnstile: use solve_turnstile.

checkOnly.description: Only report the state (solved / challenge open / none), no click.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the result after the click.

name: solve_captcha
